crossRefs.note: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law, and the words which Yahweh of Armies had…

translations.web: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
translations.bsb: His chest is as hard as a rock, as hard as a lower millstone!
translations.kjv: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether
translations.asv: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, firm as the nether millstone.
